structural.no_llm_on_focus: AppRegistry/AppWatcher perform zero inference on focus events (metadata only); tested in test_application.py
structural.unauthorized_actions_blocked: PermissionBroker: privileged ops require recorded approval; desktop actions gated by auth+lease+focus (test_authorization.py, test_desktop_control.py)
structural.desktop_control_lease: Exclusive, time-bounded, pausable, fail-closed on restart (test_desktop_control.py)
structural.assistant_opt_in: assistant_enabled defaults False; all assistant IPC raises when disabled (test_assistant_ipc.py)
structural.no_second_runtime: Pi Durable subagents execute; Hyprneuro provides context/state/IPC only (extensions/app-aware.ts)
structural.prompt_cache_reuse: measured per-benchmark; cross-request KV reuse recorded as optimization target (no model-stack change)
